evidence: Architecture, ownership ADR and ordered roadmap
acceptance: Trace one design choice through implementation and its acceptance evidence
limitation: One bounded project is smaller than company-wide architecture ownership

evidence: Native Kotlin and Flutter consumers of one broker
acceptance: Both installed clients execute identical vectors over actual IPC
limitation: Two ecosystems; no universal runtime support

evidence: Android run plus actual macOS host/CLI conformance
acceptance: Shared semantic corpus passes on both named environments
limitation: Independent local jobs; no device synchronization or other PC OS claim

evidence: Baseline-controlled latency/throughput study and raw traces
acceptance: Separate queue, execution and observation costs; report uncertainty and negative results
limitation: No performance superiority before a valid comparison

evidence: Bounded resource counters, PSS/RSS diagnosis and churn evidence
acceptance: Caps hold; no retained-job/descriptor growth in declared campaign
limitation: No whole-device or all-workload optimization claim

evidence: Separate app, SDK and broker-readiness observations
acceptance: Controlled cold/resident conditions and raw launches retained
limitation: No OS boot improvement claim

evidence: Process death, timeout, teardown and race corpus
acceptance: No false success; surviving clients remain functional; limits hold
limitation: No durable recovery, production SLO or fleet history

evidence: Concurrency/arrival-rate sweep and saturation curve
acceptance: Report rejected as well as completed work; preserve bounds and second-caller progress
limitation: Local capacity only; no distributed scalability

evidence: Runnable candidate, fresh consumer, migration guide and productization assessment
acceptance: Follow a design decision into built release artifacts and consumer execution
limitation: Actual commercial shipping needs a separate permission-safe career example

evidence: Version, ownership, trust and lifecycle ADRs
acceptance: Compiled old-consumer fixtures enforce the agreed compatibility policy
limitation: Project standards do not prove enterprise-wide adoption

evidence: Contribution/review guidance and executable CI lanes
acceptance: Required meaningful checks fail on contract/authorization regressions
limitation: A documentation check is not a native runtime test; self-review stays labeled

evidence: Dated Binder/Messenger, Flutter/RN and deployment tradeoff record
acceptance: Primary sources, alternatives, revisit triggers and one upgrade rehearsal
limitation: Reading a platform guide is not hands-on platform expertise

evidence: Separate verified qualification/practical-history evidence
acceptance: Candidate can substantiate the credential or equivalent practice privately
limitation: A repository cannot create a degree; no CV or credential document published

requirement: Android or iOS framework plus system software
evidence: Android framework integration; booted AOSP service/facade and enforcing tests
acceptance: G1 proves app-accessible IPC; G3 adds executed platform build/lifecycle/security changes
limitation: App profile alone has less system-software depth; no iOS/kernel claim

evidence: Authored Flutter plugin and installed consumer
acceptance: Native channel invokes SDK/Binder; cancel, loss and disposal behavior execute
limitation: Flutter satisfies the alternative; no React Native expertise claim

evidence: Process/thread/identity walkthrough tied to traces and platform build
acceptance: Explain and reproduce service registration, supervision, permission and isolation behavior
limitation: Using or extending userspace OS facilities is not kernel implementation

evidence: Observed failure or bottleneck investigation with alternatives and regression
acceptance: Retain failing evidence, hypothesis/test, minimal change and repeat measurement
limitation: Do not manufacture a field incident or promise a successful speedup

evidence: RFC, concise walkthrough and actual review/career collaboration example
acceptance: Docs explain choices; real participants or historical evidence establish collaboration
limitation: Solo docs and AI proposals do not prove cross-team leadership

evidence: Deep Android work, macOS comparison and honest support matrix
acceptance: Run declared profiles and explain their distinct boundaries
limitation: iOS, Fuchsia and ChromeOS are examples, not an all-platform mandate

evidence: Actual permission-safe partner example or substantive voluntary upstream interaction
acceptance: Attributable real interaction and its technical outcome; none assumed
limitation: A public repo, self-authored integration or unanswered issue is not a partnership

evidence: Separately verified professional history
acceptance: Dates and responsibilities can be substantiated through appropriate private evidence
limitation: Project geography, hosting or naming proves no professional tenure

evidence: Actual cross-border technical work and communication evidence
acceptance: Real consented participants, contribution and outcomes can be explained
limitation: English docs enable participation but do not prove it
